narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The mean comes from dividing, so I divide one hundred and thirty four by fifteen, about nine.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But fifteen days of about one hundred and thirty rolls each cannot make a total of about nine.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Dividing was done to make the mean, so to undo it we must do the opposite.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, divide the sum by fifteen, and you should get the mean back.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Or estimate with a round number. A mean near one hundred and thirty five gives about two thousand over fifteen days.
